definition: w_{t,i} = softmax over i<=t in the same doc-mask segment of (s_i - gamma (t-i)); horizon = 1/(1-exp(-gamma)) (null when gamma = 0); score = bounded s = 10.0*tanh(raw/10.0) from last_gate['s'] (absent for pool_s0, s = 0). window stats on row 0 of the first 8 batches per source, all positions of those rows: ess = 1/sum w^2, exp_entropy = exp(-sum w log w), lookback = sum w (t-i), ctx = tokens available (t - segment start + 1); '_ctx_ge_512' restricts to positions with ctx >= 512 (window not cut by a document start).
